## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 2 июн. 2026 г. - 14 июл. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Fjgfnjh_, 14 июл. 2026 г., 2/5: "I read the book and it helped a lot. I had heard that the author put the book everywhere to help the most people and that was very welcoming to hear. Being suddenly locked out and charged is NOT the principles the book taught, it is greedy scummy practices. I didn’t even make any account it just lied about the free capabilities until I’d been invested for a month. Growing as a person shouldn’t be a subscription. Shameful, I look at the book Atomic habits differently now and that’s such a huge let down."
            2. _Toadanator92_, 2 июн. 2026 г., 2/5: "I love what the app promises and the design of it but the in application subscription is overpriced and both the free and paid tiers just don’t deliver enough."
            3. _imnotchris_, 15 июн. 2026 г., 5/5: "I’ve tried a lot of ‘motivation’ apps but honestly most of them had a paywall. This app keeps its simple, but effective at the same time"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 29 июл. 2026 г. - 29 июл. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Roosteroy_, 29 июл. 2026 г., 2/5: "The app will not let me log an activity when I complete it. I get a message box stating “Cannot log a future date.” Tomorrow is the future, not today. When I complete a task today, I want to mark it completed as soon as it’s completed, not wait till tomorrow morning to log it. Also, completed tasks that I have logged, randomly disappear from the calendar. For two of my tasks, the dashboard shows that I have x number of days that the task has been completed, but the calendar is blank. I like the idea, but the glitches are making me question whether to bother with the app, and I’m certainly not going to upgrade to a paid version."
<!--/ir-theme-->
